answer: Best IRB CZ pair on garnet (calibration set edea61a8-0087-446a-836a-66ff46ee5413) is QB12-QB17, fidelity 0.99878 (uncertainty 0.00037). The runner-up is QB12-QB7 at 0.99878, which is essentially tied. I submitted a native Bell circuit directly on QB12 and QB17 to garnet:mock with 100 shots. It used prx gates, one CZ, and measured both qubits (keys m0, m1). Counts were 00: 54 and 11: 46. The mock job cost no credits.
